Title: Back to School -  Recommended Hardware  | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/news/back-school-recommended-hardware
Published: 2019-07-31T18:29:15.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
If your budget is tight, which is usually the case for most students, then consider this last recommendation the: ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2070 AMP Extreme. Still featuring the latest NVIDIA Turing Architecture (same as this card’s bigger brothers), this particular 2070 AMP Extreme that has features and performance that can hold its own against higher-end cards. The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 2070 AMP Extreme can still be a great performer during intensive rendering sessions and when the homework, projects, and exams are all done, switch over to your favorite PC game and enjoy the silky smooth frames and fluid graphics this and the other cards have to offer.
